title: Chronic Lymphocytic Leukemia Registry Study - Multicenter Prospective National Study
brief_summary: A prospective, multicenter national observational study for patients diagnosed as chronic lymphocytic leukemia across 25 centers in Turkey
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients diagnosed as CLL
* 18 years or older
* Able and willing to provide the written informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* Younger than 18 years
